verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah, And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah,
And let my cry come unto thee.

verses.text: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress: Incline thine ear unto me; In the day when I call answer me speedily.

segments.text: Hide not thy face from me in the day of my distress:
Incline thine ear unto me;
In the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.text: For my days consume away like smoke, And my bones are burned as a firebrand.

segments.text: For my days consume away like smoke,
And my bones are burned as a firebrand.

verses.text: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; For I forget to eat my bread.

segments.text: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered;
For I forget to eat my bread.

verses.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning My bones cleave to my flesh.

segments.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning
My bones cleave to my flesh.

verses.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

segments.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness;
I am become as an owl of the waste places.

verses.text: I watch, and am become like a sparrow That is alone upon the house-top.

segments.text: I watch, and am become like a sparrow
That is alone upon the house-top.

verses.text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; They that are mad against me do curse by me.

segments.text: Mine enemies reproach me all the day;
They that are mad against me do curse by me.

verses.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,

segments.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread,
And mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

segments.text: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath:
For thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

verses.text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; And I am withered like grass.

segments.text: My days are like a shadow that declineth;
And I am withered like grass.

verses.text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.

segments.text: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever;
And thy memorial
name
unto all generations.

verses.text: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion; For it is time to have pity upon her, Yea, the set time is come.

segments.text: Thou wilt arise, and have mercy upon Zion;
For it is time to have pity upon her,
Yea, the set time is come.

verses.text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, And have pity upon her dust.

segments.text: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones,
And have pity upon her dust.

verses.text: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

segments.text: So the nations shall fear the name of Jehovah,
And all the kings of the earth thy glory.

verses.text: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.

segments.text: For Jehovah hath built up Zion;
He hath appeared in his glory.

verses.text: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

segments.text: He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute,
And hath not despised their prayer.

verses.text: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.

segments.text: This shall be written for the generation to come;
And a people which shall be created shall praise Jehovah.

verses.text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

segments.text: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary;
From heaven did Jehovah behold the earth;

verses.text: To hear the sighing of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

segments.text: To hear the sighing of the prisoner;
To loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.text: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion, And his praise in Jerusalem;

segments.text: That men may declare the name of Jehovah in Zion,
And his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.text: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

segments.text: When the peoples are gathered together,
And the kingdoms, to serve Jehovah.

verses.text: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

segments.text: He weakened my strength in the way;
He shortened my days.

verses.text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: Thy years are throughout all generations.

segments.text: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days:
Thy years are throughout all generations.

verses.text: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

segments.text: Of old didst thou lay the foundation of the earth;
And the heavens are the work of thy hands.

verses.text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

segments.text: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure;
Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment;
As a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.text: But thou art the same, And thy years shall have no end.

segments.text: But thou art the same,
And thy years shall have no end.

verses.text: The children of thy servants shall continue, And their seed shall be established before thee.

segments.text: The children of thy servants shall continue,
And their seed shall be established before thee.

headings.text: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before Jehovah.
